consequence.statement: Deployments rendered by the chart now include the configured image pull secrets when service accounts aren't created, where previously they did not; the release note states no failure, only this changed rendering.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds the configured image pull secrets to the chart's Deployments in cases where service accounts aren't created, where previously they were not added there.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the release note names no Helm value key, CRD field, flag or other typed subject; it only describes a change in how the chart renders Deployments
